value.rationale: Smooth genus-two curves equipped simultaneously with the natural double cover and a degree-three map constitute a motivated marked Hurwitz/moduli family. Exact complete counts of maps and Frobenius branch strata, not merely an arbitrary coefficient slice, reveal three distinct embedded orbits attaining the known bound. Two differing trigonal rational total-ramification profiles coexist with the same ordinary Jacobian and Weil polynomial; that structural information is useful as a small-characteristic benchmark for marked moduli and arithmetic geometry.
